name: Voxel Format Generation
definition: Converts 3D Gaussian Splats into a sparse voxel octree for collision detection, outputting metadata (.voxel.json) and binary data (.voxel.bin), optionally generating a .collision.glb mesh.
summary: Voxel Format Generation converts 3D Gaussian Splats into sparse voxel octrees for collision detection, distinguished by its integration of scene topology analysis and direct watertight mesh generation.
